# Seasonal Fun media

The release bundles the author's original Halloween model `marshmallow-animated.glb` and the three accompanying sound files: `laugh.mp3`, `balloon-pop.mp3`, `bubble-pops.mp3`. The supplied transparent St. Martin animation `St_Martin_korrigiert.webp` is used by the scene renderer.

These media files must be committed alongside the source code before release. They are not licensed under the JavaScript MIT license.

St. Nicholas needs `Nikolaus_ohne_Wasserzeichen_transparent.webp` (animated WebP with alpha) and `Nikolaus_Mirelo_Ton_15s.mp3` (synchronized 15-second sound). Both must be included in the distributed `dist/assets/` directory. Sound provider: Mirelo AI (https://mirelo.ai/); Free Plan output requires visible attribution and non-commercial use. See `SEASONAL_ASSET_SOURCES.md`.

St. Martin also requires `St_Martin_Mirelo_Ton_9s.mp3` (9.25-second Mirelo soundtrack). Sound provider: Mirelo AI (https://mirelo.ai/), credited in the repository README and rights file. See `SEASONAL_ASSET_SOURCES.md`.
